title: fixelconvert
description:
Convert between the old format fixel image (.msf / .msh) and the new fixel directory format.



References:

name.description: assign a different name to the value field output (Default: value). Do not include the file extension.
name.title: name

nii.description: output the index, directions and data file in NIfTI format instead of .mif
nii.title: nii

out_size.description: also output the 'size' field from the old format
out_size.title: out_size

template.description: specify an existing fixel directory (in the new format) to which the new output should conform
template.title: template

value.description: nominate the data file to import to the 'value' field in the old format
value.title: value

in_size.description: import data for the 'size' field in the old format
in_size.title: in_size

quiet.description: do not display information messages or progress status; alternatively, this can be achieved by setting the MRTRIX_QUIET environment variable to a non-empty string.
quiet.title: quiet

force.description: force overwrite of output files (caution: using the same file as input and output might cause unexpected behaviour).
force.title: force

nthreads.description: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).
nthreads.title: nthreads

key.description: temporarily set the value of an MRtrix config file entry.
key.title: key

value.description: temporarily set the value of an MRtrix config file entry.
value.title: value

config.description: temporarily set the value of an MRtrix config file entry.
config.title: config

help.description: display this information page and exit.
help.title: help
